cases.purpose: For the repeated local hour 2024-11-03 01:30:00 under EST5EDT,M3.2.0/2,M11.1.0/2 the candidate yields both valid epochs (1730611800 EDT and 1730615400 EST) depending on the preceding conversion in the same shell (libc mktime with tm_isdst=-1 keeps the previous offset as its guess), and every result is one of the two valid epochs
cases.oracle: The two valid UTC instants of the repeated local hour derived from the US rule (01:30 EDT = 05:30Z, 01:30 EST = 06:30Z) and independently derived epochs of the summer and winter priming dates; a synthetic RTC/clock recorder answers successive RTC reads with successive calendars and records the clock sets
cases.comparison: Recorded clock_settime seconds for the two priming dates and the fold, with the fold run after a summer date, after a winter date and after itself.
cases.script:
[[ $UID == 2000 && $EUID == 2000 && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r marker </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
IFS= read -r vendor </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
[[ $vendor == QEMU && $marker =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || exit 125
[[ $(type -t hwclock) == builtin ]] || exit 125
: >rtc
HS=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/mig-w6-hwclock-synth2.py
export TZ='EST5EDT,M3.2.0/2,M11.1.0/2'
# seq LABEL RTCS-JSON : one shell, two successive hwclock --hctosys --localtime runs answered with the listed RTC calendars
seq() {
  printf '{"rtcs": %s}\n' "$2" >synth.json
  local out; out=$(/usr/bin/python3 "$HS" "$BASH" --noprofile --norc -c 'hwclock --hctosys --localtime --noadjfile --rtc /tmp/parity-case/rtc; hwclock --hctosys --localtime --noadjfile --rtc /tmp/parity-case/rtc' 2>&1)
  local first= second= l
  while IFS= read -r l; do
    if [[ $l == clock_settime* ]]; then s=${l##* sec=}; s=${s%% *}; if [[ -z $first ]]; then first=$s; else second=$s; fi; fi
  done <<<"$out"
  eval "${1}_first=$first ${1}_second=$second"
  echo "$1: first=$first second=$second"
}
summer='[0,0,12,4,6,124,0,0,0]'; winter='[0,30,8,15,0,124,0,0,0]'; fold='[0,30,1,3,10,124,0,0,0]'
seq A "[$summer,$fold]"
seq B "[$winter,$fold]"
seq C "[$fold,$fold]"
v() { [[ $1 == 1730611800 || $1 == 1730615400 ]] && echo 1 || echo 0; }
echo "fold-after-summer-valid=$(v $A_second) fold-after-winter-valid=$(v $B_second) fold-alone-valid=$(v $C_first)"
echo "both-valid-epochs-observed=$([[ $A_second != "$B_second" ]] && echo 1 || echo 0)"
cases.stdout:
A: first=1720108800 second=1730611800
B: first=1705325400 second=1730615400
C: first=1730611800 second=1730611800
fold-after-summer-valid=1 fold-after-winter-valid=1 fold-alone-valid=1
both-valid-epochs-observed=1
